html:
Unique Research · Company / Funding · August 30, 2022

On Aug 25, 2022, Hangzhou cloud-data platform Shuxin Network (数新网络) (founded Jul 2020) closed a multi-million RMB Pre-A from CICC Capital, Hongfeng Capital, Zhonghao Capital for talent and GTM. Founder Chen Tingliang: ex-Alibaba Cloud big-data R&D director; founded Yushanshan / DataWorks / Shujia. ~70 staff, 80% R&D (Alibaba, ICBC…). Built Zhejiang Financial Comprehensive Service Platform: 200+ banks, 1,000+ credit products, 110k enterprises, >¥2T credit by Aug’21. Product line DataCyber: CyberMeta (one-stop lakehouse), CyberOPS (cluster ops), CyberScience (ML credit models), CyberExcel (Excel-mode BI for frontline).

— END —
